description: This file contains mathematical functions for matrix and vector operations, including polynomial root finding, kurtosis, correlation, covariance, standard deviation, variance, mean, transpose, multiply, and eigenvalue calculations, along with utility functions for vector and matrix creation and printing.

methods.name: polynomial_3
methods.description: Calculates roots of a cubic polynomial using iterative search and calls polynomial_2 for quadratic root calculation.

methods.name: polynomial_2
methods.description: Calculates roots of a quadratic polynomial.

methods.name: kurtosis
methods.description: Computes kurtosis for each column of a matrix.

methods.name: correlation
methods.description: Calculates the correlation matrix of input data.

methods.name: covariance
methods.description: Calculates the covariance matrix of input data.

methods.name: stddev
methods.description: Calculates standard deviation of a matrix.

methods.name: find_eigens
methods.description: Placeholder for eigenvalue and eigenvector calculation, currently only checks matrix validity.

methods.name: vector
methods.description: Creates a vector with specified values.

methods.name: matrix
methods.description: Creates a matrix with specified values.
